rules.note: LOCKED team layer: the agent never locks, unlocks, arms, or disarms — security state changes are the owner's hands only, in the vendor app, for any initiator, ever. A compromised or confused agent must not be able to open the house or silence its alarm.

LOCKED team layer: in this agent DELETE means recordings and evidence — camera clips, doorbell footage, event history. Deleting them is irreversible and destroys the record of what happened; the agent never does it, for any initiator, ever.

No unattended money: a purchase proposed by anything other than the owner at the keyboard — a routine, a handoff, a remembered trigger, the system — denies outright rather than asking whoever happens to be around. Only an owner-initiated purchase may even ask (purchases-ask).

A message to anyone who is not a known contact routes to the owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver. payload.to_contact marks a known contact; absent (null) or false counts as non-contact — an unknown recipient is treated as a stranger, the fail-safe direction. Hand_off outranks ask, so this fires ahead of messages-ask whenever it matches.

Unattended actuation asks: any device actuation (EXECUTE) started by a non-owner initiator — routine, handoff, memory, system — asks a human first, even where the owner's identical action is pre-approved (devices-pre-approved). Ask outranks pre_approved, so a 2am automation turning lights on asks where the owner tapping the same switch would not. Locked security kinds still deny — deny outranks ask.

Owner-initiated purchases ask a human first, on the exact recorded payload — the agent never checks out on standing approval. Non-owner purchases never reach this rule: unattended-spend-never denies them at the stricter tier.

Messages ask a human first. This general COMMUNICATE ask is what a message to a known contact (payload.to_contact == true) lands on; anything else in this class is claimed earlier and stricter by messages-to-noncontacts-handoff.

Standing approval, bounded to exactly these owner-run device kinds: lights, media playback, and thermostat. Comfort actuation the owner asked for runs without a prompt each time. Any other EXECUTE kind is NOT covered by this rule — see home.garage.open in the README, which denies by the fail-closed default. Non-owner runs of even these kinds ask first (unattended-actuation-asks).

Reading sensors, climate state, and camera snapshots is free for every initiator, including unattended routines — a house agent that cannot check the temperature or a snapshot unattended is not much of an agent. Reads change nothing and expose nothing outside the home.
